title.zh: 为自定义域名添加SSL证书

descriptions.zh:
- 此功能面向API提供者。
- SSL证书必须与域名匹配。
- 绑定SSL证书后，可提供基于HTTPS的API服务。
- HTTPS双向认证场景才需要填写根证书，一般情况不需要填写。
descriptions.en:
- This operation is intended for API providers.

- The SSL certificate must match the custom domain name.

- After the SSL certificate is bound, HTTPS-based API services become available.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi set-domain-certificate --group-id 927d50c0f2e54b359919923d908bb015 --domain-name api.demo.com --certificate-name test_cert --certificate-body -----BEGIN_CERTIFICATE-----_MIIEpAIBAAKCAQEA8GjIleJ7rlo86mtbwcDnUfqzTQAm4b3zZEo1aKsfAuwcvCud_...._-----END_CERTIFICATE----- --certificate-private-key -----BEGIN_RSA_PRIVATE_KEY-----_MIIEpAIBAAKCAQEA8GjIleJ7rlo86mtbwcDnUfqzTQAm4b3zZEo1aKsfAuwcvCud_...._-----END_RSA_PRIVATE_KEY----- --ca-certificate-body CA_certificate_encoding_content --ssl-verify-depth 2 --ssl-ocsp-enable true --ssl-ocsp-cache-enable true --client-cert-s-dn-pass-through true --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi SetDomainCertificate --region cn-hangzhou --CertificateBody '-----BEGIN_CERTIFICATE-----_MIIEpAIBAAKCAQEA8GjIleJ7rlo86mtbwcDnUfqzTQAm4b3zZEo1aKsfAuwcvCud_...._-----END_CERTIFICATE-----' --SslVerifyDepth 2 --DomainName 'api.demo.com' --ClientCertSDnPassThrough true --CaCertificateBody CA_certificate_encoding_content --SslOcspCacheEnable true --CertificatePrivateKey '-----BEGIN_RSA_PRIVATE_KEY-----_MIIEpAIBAAKCAQEA8GjIleJ7rlo86mtbwcDnUfqzTQAm4b3zZEo1aKsfAuwcvCud_...._-----END_RSA_PRIVATE_KEY-----' --CertificateName test_cert --GroupId 927d50c0f2e54b359919923d908bb015 --SslOcspEnable true
